publication.evidenceLocation: GitHub v3.3.0 release assets and exact main Pages run
publication.boundary: Local acceptance recorded here; exact published commit, hosted artifact and live hashes are external to avoid self-reference.

priorEvidence.boundary: Prior live source refresh, County documents, research rendering and native-model evidence retain their original dates and versions; this local gate does not re-establish them.

releaseGate.boundary: Exact tracked and new public source, test, configuration, workflow, documentation and seed equality with the independently gated copy; the acceptance receipt is excluded to avoid self-reference. Final guides were captured in this copy and checked by the gate. Shared dependency installation; hosted CI independently installs the lockfile on Ubuntu.

focusedRuns.boundary: Direct-reader foreign-TOC admission and legacy default compatibility
Real FIFO regular-file custody, bounded receipts, reverse default identity and producer contention

awakeAlertProducer.boundary: Independent actual same-root mixed producer rerun after verifying the exact host-sleep interval; no runtime or deadline changes.

finalSharedBoundary.boundary: Fresh independent read-only review after root fixes; focused runs overlap and are separate from aggregate release-gate counts.

pagesBehavior.boundary: Real isolated Pages CLI mutation controls passed unchanged deadlines; full suite and final committed export/browser are separate evidence.

profileAndPublication.boundary: Fresh independent read-only review of profile validation, loaders, protected roots and captured identity. Focused offline tests are separate from the full gate.

geographyAndEvents.boundary: Fresh independent review verified four corrected foreign-profile/root/event-contract/UTC offset findings through real owned filesystem and producer flows.

searchVectorsNews.boundary: Fresh independent review verified three corrected reverse-vector-identity, writer-root and canonical-source-name findings using real local HTTP probes and related suites.

retainedFailures.disposition: Imports inserted before two Bun shebangs caused TypeScript parsing failures. Shebangs restored; the final full gate is independently retained.

Canonical Redwood endpoint fixture corrected through explicit loopback transport scope. Retained transcript case exceeded its unchanged five-second test bound and affected the next fixture; its isolated rerun passed 5/0,32 assertions. The final full gate is required separately; no established cause is claimed for that intermittent timeout.

additionalRetainedGateEvidence.phase: first full plain suite before final repairs
additionalRetainedGateEvidence.disposition: Corrected incomplete geographic/insight fixtures and stale README version. Browser/process deadlines also failed; separate focused reruns passed. No definitive cause is attributed to those earlier intermittent failures.
Both fenced suites passed, but its source snapshot predates final direct-reader and regular-file admission fixes; it does not certify this release.

additionalRetainedGateEvidence.phase: current-source gate on a suspended host
additionalRetainedGateEvidence.disposition: Local power-state log records sleep intervals matching the wall-deadline failures. Final validation ran with a process-scoped idle-sleep inhibitor; application/test deadlines remain unchanged.
The idle-only assertion did not keep the Mac out of maintenance sleep. Final gate used verified task-owned display, idle and activity assertions; no application/test timeout changed.

methods: geographic contracts with explicit domain inputs
configured civil-day timezone and calendar namespace
explicit news relevance/endpoints and independent source IDs
profile-owned lexical indexes and staged vector metadata
reusableCivicMethods.boundary: No second live city, authenticated request multitenancy, non-ecode360 provider or generic authored deployment claim. Regional adapters, weekly/alert batches, private digest, scheduler and authored GUI/Pages refuse unsupported alternate profiles.

documentation.boundary: Final generated guides and version references are captured in the independent gate copy, with separate fresh read-only review. The exact selected GitHub file is checked after publication.

candidatePages.boundary: Actual working-tree candidate export, validator and browser execution; the baseline commit is not a source identity for pending changes. Hosted collection/artifact and live service acceptance are separate.

deferredAcceptance.boundary: Actual recipients, private consumers, persistent hosts, independent human interpretation, representative source coverage, a reviewed alternate deployment and separately owned reproduction remain open.
